messages:
maya: Quick check 1: post-launch micro-iteration for Results UI. We need to settle bugs vs one high-impact enhancement. Proposing 10d cycle: clear P0/P1s, dedicate one sprint slot for feature experiment. opinions?

devon: +1. We're seeing duplication regressions in dedupe on ~7% of queries. that's P0 for some customers.

tara: Agree we must fix dedupe first. Can we scope enhancement to be toggleable so rollback is easy?

maya: Exactly. My proposal: enhancement = "result annotations toggle" behind flag + A/B for 2 weeks. If stability issues persist we turn off.

ops-bot: New ticket created: #2117 1 - dedupe-regression-prod (assigned: dev team).

eva: Customer B reported increased noise in top results after last deploy. CS flagged as priority but not outage. Might be related to dedupe.

devon: If we fix dedupe quickly, we can use the enhancement slot for annotations. If not, enhancement gets bumped.

tara: For rollout, suggest canary at 10% traffic for 24h, metrics to watch: error rate, top10 overlap, CTR. Rollback if error rate >3% above baseline OR top10 overlap drop >8%.

maya: Add acceptance criteria for annotation experiment: 1) toggle via feature-flag, 2) annotations don't change ranking when disabled, 3) instrumentation records click-through per cohort, 4) experiment window 14 days.

eva: I'll consolidate CS asks into 1 pager and mark customers for the A/B cohort.

devon: ETA: dedupe hotfix PR by EOD tomorrow if we can repro locally. If not, need more infra traces.

tara: Owner assignments: devon = dedupe fix, tara = rollout + dashboards, maya = PM + success criteria, eva = CS coordination.

maya: Decision: 10d micro-iteration starts Monday. Priority order: P0 dedupe fix > P1 quota edge-cases > enhancement (annotation toggle) if dedupe fixed in sprint. Meeting: quick groom 09:30 Mon. drop one-line acceptance bullets before EOD Fri. :calendar:
